the renal PGE2 production, which is increased in cirrhosis, is the cause of the maintenance and even the increase of juxtamedulare blood flow.

PGE2, by maintaining juxtamedullar flow, could be responsible, at least in part, for the maintenance of renal function in cirrhosis.
